title: Analysis code and results for "An interferon-stimulated gene programme marks palbociclib resistance in ER-positive breast cancer models: nested machine-learning validation and structure-based repurposing against STAT1"
description:
Analysis code, result tables and figures for an integrative study of palbociclib resistance in oestrogen receptor-positive breast cancer models.

Three independent palbociclib-resistant ER+ model datasets (GSE130437, GSE222367, GSE229235) are analysed with empirical Bayes moderated linear models and integrated by robust rank aggregation, yielding 378 reproducible expression changes dominated by interferon-stimulated genes. A STRING protein-protein interaction network identifies 14 hub genes, all interferon-stimulated, with STAT1 the most connected. LASSO, SVM-RFE and random-forest Boruta select a 17-gene core signature whose apparent cross-validated AUC of 1.00 falls to 0.65 under fully nested leave-one-dataset-out validation in which differential expression and feature selection are repeated inside every training fold. A LASSO-Cox risk score trained in ER+/HER2-negative TCGA-BRCA is prognostic there but does not replicate in METABRIC and does not predict response to ribociclib in serial single-cell biopsies from the FELINE trial (GSE158724). Approved drugs are docked against the phosphotyrosine subsite of the STAT1 SH2 domain after redocking validation (1.24 A RMSD). A specificity-verified RT-qPCR assay design for the core genes is included.

Every value in the associated manuscript was produced by this code; none was entered by hand. The negative validation results are included in full.
